2014_spells.booming-blade.description: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects and then becomes sheathed in booming energy until the start of your next turn. If the target willingly moves 5 feet or more before then, the target takes 1d8 thunder damage, and the spell ends.
2014_spells.booming-blade.effectSummary: Deal 1d8 thunder damage to a target within Self (5-foot radius)
2014_spells.booming-blade.fullDescriptio: Using 1 action, you brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. If the target willingly moves 5 feet or more before then, the target takes 1d8 thunder damage, and the spell ends; On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects and then becomes sheathed in booming energy until the start of your next turn; At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra 1d8 thunder damage on a hit, and the damage the target takes for moving increases to 2d8; At 11th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8 and the moving damage increases to 3d8; At 17th level, the extra damage increases to 3d8 and the moving damage increases to 4d8. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects and then becomes sheathed in booming energy until the start of your next turn.
